note: Routing bars are properties of an embedding model, never of the user's chat model. Each entry was measured with router_live over 108 labeled requests over 36 skills (72 English built-in eval inputs + 36 Arabic/French, evals/skill_routing/multilingual.json) on Q8_0 weights, Apple Metal, 2026-10-10 (v2: re-measured after supplier-invoice-review joined the skill set; v1 was 106 cases / 35 skills). An embedder with no entry is UNCALIBRATED: the router still ranks but never recommends. Re-measure (and bump `version`) when the model, quantization, instruction policy or skill set changes. Matryoshka-truncated indexes (EmbeddingGemma 2) are separate entries keyed by `dimension`; 128-d measured 48% top-1, below the broken-embedder floor, so it has no entry and never recommends. Selection rule for every entry: highest coverage with precision-when-confident >= 0.75 on the sweep grid.
